requirement: A patient has an MRI appointment 90 days away. Patients should be able to find potentially earlier MRI appointments within 25 km.

user_stories.story: As a patient, I want to search for MRI appointments within 25 km so that I can find an earlier option.
As a patient, I want to see whether each opening is verified so that I don't rely on unconfirmed availability.
As a patient, I want to know if my requisition is accepted so that I only pursue options I can use.
As a patient, I want a booking handoff I approve myself so that nothing is submitted without my consent.

acceptance_criteria.gherkin:
Given a patient in Toronto
When they search for MRI within 25 km
Then only facilities within 25 km (straight-line, inclusive) are returned

Given an advertised but unconfirmed opening
When results are ranked
Then it is listed as an UNVERIFIED_POSSIBILITY and never as a confirmed alternative

Given a facility that does not accept the patient's requisition format
When eligibility is evaluated
Then the facility is INELIGIBLE and the patient is told to contact their clinician

Given a selected opening
When the patient requests a booking handoff
Then the workflow pauses for patient approval and no booking is marked confirmed without provider confirmation

ambiguities.question: Are only verified appointments eligible, or may advertised/unverified openings be presented?
Does an earlier slot qualify if the facility cannot accept the patient's requisition?
What happens if no appointment exists within the radius?
Can users expand the search radius, and who approves it?
'Earlier' relative to what baseline - the patient's existing appointment date?
Must accessibility needs (e.g., wheelchair access) filter results?
How recent must availability data be to count as verified?
